title: WGPU Mask Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: The shared WGPU test readback/render harness now covers path, clip, and material conformance tests, but the mask conformance tests still duplicate the same final-render readback helpers. This keeps ADR 0239 / ADR 0273 evidence noisier than necessary without adding behavior coverage.

repro.summary: Mask-related WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through the shared integration-test support module while preserving existing mask assertions.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test mask_gradient_conformance --test mask_image_conformance -j 1

gates.name: mask-conformance-batch
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test mask_gradient_conformance --test mask_image_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named mask tests migrated successfully. Future paint/effect/text families should start narrower follow-ons instead of widening this one.
